june_reference.cooling: substrate-embedded micro-channel, channels adjacent to the GaN switch layer (June-2026 Sec. IV-D)

model_form_caveat: June places micro-channels INSIDE the substrate adjacent to the GaN switch layer. This model applies an equivalent Robin boundary at the TIM top surface, as every earlier phase did, so that Phase-0F results stay comparable with 0B-0E. The calibration matches the junction temperature, not the internal temperature field; a substrate-side boundary would cool the converter layer more directly and the die less.
